scope: Offline retry and lineage regression checks; not runtime qualification.
verified_facts: convertNativeLayers catches keep and register failures into layer outcome codes, then writes parent state.
runDerivativeJob accepts a normal return; acceptUspJobAttempt writes succeeded.
nativeParentState promises re-enrolment for ordinary coded layer failures.
The base queue treated any succeeded job as terminal unless an officer CRS answer was supplied.

decision.choice: Persist nativeDerivativeRetry in the parent plan_ref when any layer outcome carries a code.
decision.why: The queue can honor explicit re-enrolment without changing job authority or replacing partial words.
decision.queue: Reuse queued/running jobs first; only the latest matching terminal job can suppress re-enrolment.
decision.reset: A conversion with no coded outcomes writes fresh parent state without the retry marker.
decision.lineage: Existing keptChildTx matches exact lineage, hash and bytes before opening another receipt.

observed: A succeeded partial keep result blocked re-enrolment.
A succeeded result with a child registration failure blocked re-enrolment.
An older succeeded job hid the queued job created by a CRS answer.

environment.guard: Reject environment-file and restricted-path reads before filesystem access.

real_inputs.classification: test_only; foreign development inputs, not Indian operational evidence

limits: No Docker, live database, live object store or external service qualification.
The registry D1 artifact test skipped because its explicit external artifact pin was unset.
The marker applies to conversions completed with this change; no historical partial-state backfill was run.
next: Review and integrate; qualify re-enrolment on an authorized isolated runtime later.
